dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: How dare a grade seven nobody speak and act so arrogantly...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Grade seven pawn?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Martial artists are divided into nine grades. One's the highest, nine the lowest.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Now, I was escorting someone from Yanshang Teahouse to Qiaoying Village two days ago, when I ran into this... mouthy pest!

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: I couldn't stop myself from exchanging a few pointers with him, but what do you know, he was just a worthless grade seven.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: In the end, the strong keep it on the down low. I don't know why those clowns are so fond of acting out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Farewell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And just who is doing the ranking?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Me, of course. I've seen many martial artists in my time, so I've got confidence in my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Let me put it this way. There's an excellent martial artist named Huangshan who can be found on the trade routes linking Liyue and Mondstadt. She's barely a grade three.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Sun Yu, a Guhua Disciple, wields a swift and sharp sword, and he'd be a grade two.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: A grade one, then, has to be an absolute master.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: In my opinion, Branch Master Lan of the Adventurers' Guild would count.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What grade are you?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: As for me, my skill is still lacking. You can consider me a grade three.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What grade is Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: Huh. How did you know our boss' name?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: As far as I know, she's gentle, refined, and capable of resolving problems with just a few words. I've never seen her fight anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: But can you really rate those who never fight? Would they even reach grade nine? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What grade am I?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: If I'm being honest, I've never heard of you...

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: But based on your bright gaze and long breaths, you must be a grade two at least.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: At a bare minimum, I'm the highest grade!

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: You really don't hold back, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Hanquan
dialogues.text: I'd hope to see a few of your moves one day, should fate permit.
